critical_code_review_comments: Concepts.jsx line 243-289: funding-compare-card cleanly gates on cmpReady with a funding-compare-loading placeholder — good UX for the ~1-2s dual runProjection await. No flash of stale data.

Concepts.jsx line 263: fc-gainpct Pct component (debounced ~350ms). Confirmed working: only the 'Leave IRA' projection re-runs on change (Deplete column stable across 66.67% -> 20% edit), which correctly reflects the engine invariant that the Deplete path never sells taxable assets.

Analytics.jsx: printWithConcepts() correctly toggles body.print-concepts around window.print(). The persistent .concepts-print-block approach (rendered always at opacity:0 off-screen) is a robust choice — SVGs are pre-laid-out at fixed 720px width, so print CSS just flips display:block instead of fighting Recharts's ResponsiveContainer on the print event.
index.css: The dual-condition hide (@media screen opacity:0 + @media print display:none unless body.print-concepts) is correct and testable — verified both branches with page.emulate_media.
ConceptsPrint.jsx line 92: FundingCompareBars receives width={CW} (fixed) — bypasses ResponsiveContainer measurement issues that historically break print. Good pattern.

Non-blocking / maintainability nit: fc-gainpct's underlying <input> testid resolves to blank innerText at the wrapper level (Pct component); tests need `[data-testid="fc-gainpct"] input` selector. This is fine but a duplicate testid on the raw input could simplify E2E.
